decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building(s) is/are occupied/used).
Condition : 3 - All new internal and external works, including works of making good, shall match the original work in both type, colour and dimensions of materials and in detailed execution.

Condition : 4 - The extension would be in keeping with the character of the property, would not harm neighbouring residential amenity and would preserve and enhance Bedford Park Conservation Area and the setting of adjoining listed buildings. The development complies with policies ENV-B.1.1., ENV-B.2.2, ENV-B.2.5 and H.6.4 of the Council's Unitary Development Plan.
description: Erection of single storey rear/side conservatory and replacement of side window to dining room with encasement window to dwellinghouse
